meta.title: 어디쯤 택배
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (어디쯤 택배, a parcel-tracking app told as a case file (fictional app)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 어디쯤 택배, a parcel-tracking app told as a case file (fictional app)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: A case file printed like a newspaper: newsprint #EDE8DC and cream card for the prints, ink #1D1B19 for every halftone dot and typed letter, one rubber-stamp red #D23B2E (stamps, pins, string, the route and the dot wipe), a manila folder #D8B878 on a dark lamp-lit desk #3B2F27 and a cork board.
rationale.type: Black Han Sans for the stencilled and stamped words; Nanum Gothic Coding as the typewriter, each character landing with a tiny jitter and a caret.
rationale.motion: Police-procedural beats on the beat: a folder slides up, stamps slam in from 1.6x, a camera flash, typing, a redaction bar sliding off, pins popping one per beat with red string running pin to pin, a magnifier sliding over the evidence; scenes change through a dot wipe of red halftone dots.
rationale.sound: Swing at 128 BPM in F minor, a detective cue on recorded instruments (VCSL and VSCO 2 CE, CC0): vibraphone comping on the Charleston rhythm, a pizzicato walking bass, a clarinet hook, ride and brushes; typewriter keys and a bell, stamps, pin pops, a flash, a swish for each dot wipe.
rationale.visuals: All code: every picture (the parcel, its mugshot, the district map, the parcel at the door) is drawn once in greys, read back, and re-drawn as a rotated grid of ink dots sized by darkness; mounts with borders and paperclips, rough stamps cut with specks, index cards, a phone with the route drawing on its halftone map.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the case file is read, not told.
